slides.headline: SONY IS SEEKING $150,000 PER SONG FROM ANTHROPIC THIS WEEK
SAMSUNG GAVE CHATGPT ITS OWN CHIP DESIGNS. HERE IS THE CHECK THEY SKIPPED.
slides.body: Three Samsung engineers pasted proprietary semiconductor code into ChatGPT in 2023. They skipped one step: sanitizing the data before it reached OpenAI's servers.

slides.headline: CLEAN EVERY CONTRACT BEFORE YOU ASK AI ABOUT IT
slides.body: The free version of ChatGPT sends every conversation to OpenAI's servers by default. One client NDA with real names hands confidential details to a third-party company.

slides.headline: MASK ALL PAY DATA BEFORE IT REACHES AN AI TOOL
slides.body: Salary data is the paste nobody thinks twice about. One export of a pay spreadsheet sends your entire compensation structure to a third-party server.

slides.headline: $150,000 PER SONG
slides.body: That is what Sony is seeking per song from Anthropic this week for training AI on copyrighted music. Real dollar consequences are now attached to what AI tools ingest.

slides.headline: KEEP FUTURE PLANS OUT OF AI CHATS ENTIRELY
slides.body: An unannounced product, a pricing change, a deal in progress: each is legally sensitive. Pasting your strategy into any AI tool sends it to a third-party server, and most NDAs restrict exactly that.

slides.headline: DESCRIBE CUSTOMERS BY BEHAVIOR, NEVER BY NAME
slides.body:
Most business privacy policies promise customers their data stays inside the business.

Every customer name or email you paste into an AI tool goes directly to the company behind it.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 THINGS NEVER TO SHARE WITH AI
slides.body:
Proprietary code and technical specs
Client contracts and signed NDAs
Employee salary and pay data
Future business plans and deals
Customer names and personal data

Daily AI news + real skills
